    Lemma 6.6, the additional gradings #

    lem:square-zero-selected-lifts (positive-deformations.tex), last sentence: "If Λ and the M_i carry an additional grading by an abelian group, preserved by the multiplication and the actions, and μ is homogeneous for it, then all these choices may be made homogeneous for this grading."

    For a grading by an arbitrary abelian group Γ (GrΓ, gradings of the modules compatible with the actions; exists_actLiftΓ, ActLift.exists_isoΓ, exists_mapLiftΓ, through WeightExtGroup.lean), and also for finitely many additional ℤ-gradings (GΛw i, MMw i, NNw i; e.g. the coordinates of the integer weights of Section 7), compatible with the actions and the internal degree as in WeightExt.lean, and μ of weight χ i for each: the lifted actions can be chosen of weight χ (exists_actLiftW), two such lifts differ by a coordinate change of weight χ (ActLift.exists_isoW), and a map of weight ω lifts with correction of weight ω + χ (exists_mapLiftW). The corrections are the weight components of WeightExt.lean (extVanish_weights1, extVanish_weights0).
